author: r. m. falcon
title: How many companies in cities across Monongalia County received FDA citations in 2025?
text:
There were two companies in a city associated with Monongalia County that received FDA citations as a result of two inspections conducted in the county in 2025, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
No companies were cited in the previous year.
The citations in the county include:
- You did not implement procedures to ensure that all equipment is suitable for its intended purposes and properly installed, maintained, and capable of repeatedly producing valid results that could reasonably be expected to adversely affect the identity, strength, quality, or purity of a PET drug, or give erroneous or invalid test results when improperly used or maintained.
- A correction or removal, conducted to reduce a risk to health posed by a device, was not reported in writing to FDA.
- Risk analysis is inadequate and is incomplete.
Both companies cited should take voluntary actions to correct their managing operations.
The FDA routinely inspects facilities across the nation to determine if the workplace and their products are compliant with FDA-regulated laws and regulations implemented to improve overall public health. Inspection results are then disclosed publicly.
According to its website, the FDA is a government agency that is primarily responsible for monitoring the production and distribution of human and animal drugs, biological products, medical supplies and tobacco products for safety and quality.
| Company Name | Area of Business | Inspection Date | Issue Cited |
|---|---|---|---|
| Omnia Medical | Devices | 07/28/2025 | Report of risk to health |
| Omnia Medical | Devices | 07/28/2025 | Design Validation – Risk analysis not performed/inadequate |
| Omnia Medical | Devices | 07/28/2025 | Environmental control Lack of or inadequate procedures |
| SOFIE Company | Drugs | 08/28/2025 | Equipment procedures |
Information in this article was obtained from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. The source data can be found here.
